paper.core_task: Learning a universal real-world simulator for interactive video generation from diverse action inputs

contributions.name: A unified action-in-video-out framework for real-world simulation
contributions.author_claim_text: We take the first step toward building a universal simulator of real-world interaction by combining diverse datasets rich in along different dimensions -e.g., objects, scenes, actions, motions, language, and motor controls -in a unified action-in-video-out generative framework.
contributions.description: A universal simulator that unifies diverse datasets covering objects, scenes, actions, motions, language, and motor controls into a single action-conditioned video generation framework for real-world interaction simulation.

contributions.name: An observation prediction model parametrized by a video diffusion model
contributions.author_claim_text: We formulate the action-in-video-out framework as an observation prediction model conditioned on finite history and parametrized by a video diffusion model.
contributions.description: A video diffusion model that predicts future observations conditioned on past frames and actions, supporting autoregressive rollout for consistent long-horizon simulation.

contributions.name: Sim-to-real transfer of policies trained purely in simulation
contributions.author_claim_text: We illustrate how the simulator can enable both high-level language policies, low-level control policies, and video captioning models to generalize to the real world when trained purely in simulation, thereby bridging the sim-to-real gap.
contributions.description: Demonstration that vision-language policies, RL control policies, and captioning models trained exclusively on simulated data from UniSim can generalize to real-world robotic settings.

novelty_claims.text: The paper proposes a novel method for learning a simulator of the real world through generative modeling.
The use of a diffusion model to predict observations conditioned on actions and previous observations is a creative and effective way to fuse information from diverse datasets.
